answer: Sybil defense here is a bonded identity with a timed unlock: an agent key earns only after its operator locks capital that returns once attested work clears a challenge window, the same way a copper seal must hold until the tide of fake votes recedes before any pearl of payout is released. Cloning a key multiplies that lock, so a thousand fake agents need a thousand simultaneous stakes sitting idle, and a cluster caught voting alike forfeits all of them together. Flooding also dilutes each seat's share, driving reward per clone toward zero.
